value.rationale: The theorem calculates a complete natural commutation invariant across an infinite family of finite nonassociative division algebras and identifies an unexpected exact collision with associative matrix-ring commuting graphs. The explicit failure of element commutants to be subalgebras shows a mathematically consequential limitation of graph reconstruction beyond associative rings.
